records.title: Breaking the bottleneck in AI clusters with parallel photonic integration
records.reason: Parallel photonic integration performs collective matrix operations optically to remove the scaling bottleneck of processor clusters running distributed AI; cluster interconnect hardware for AI workloads generally, not specifically LLM inference, hence borderline.

records.title: Capability-Aware Dynamic Skill Selection for Memory-Augmented Generation
records.reason: Capability-aware dynamic skill selection chooses skills at the read stage of memory-augmented generation for multi-turn dialogue; an agent memory/generation control method without a serving or decoding mechanism, so borderline.

records.title: AuroraMem: Towards Eternal Memory in Conversational AI
records.reason: AuroraMem modularizes extraction, storage and reuse of structured memory for conversational LLM agents; an agent memory framework whose relevance is context management at inference, but with no serving efficiency contribution, hence borderline.

records.title: Episodic Memory Verbalization Using Hierarchical Representations of Life-Long Robot Experience
records.reason: Large pretrained models verbalize life-long robot episodic experience for question answering about a robot's past; a robotics application of LLMs with no inference-system content.

records.title: MAPLE: Modality-Aware Post-training and Learning Ecosystem
records.reason: MAPLE makes RL post-training of multimodal models modality-aware to cut policy-gradient variance and wasted training on irrelevant signals; a training pipeline contribution, not inference.

records.title: SISA: A Scale-In Systolic Array for GEMM Acceleration
records.reason: SISA is a scale-in systolic array redesign that handles the skewed, input-dependent GEMM shapes produced by LLM workloads, raising processing-element utilization over square arrays; a direct accelerator contribution for LLM execution, hence accept.

records.title: Selective Safety Steering via Value-Filtered Decoding
records.reason: Value-filtered decoding steers LLM sampling with a safety score only when generations are actually unsafe, avoiding unnecessary distortion; a decoding-time safety intervention, relevant to decoding but aimed at alignment rather than inference efficiency, so borderline.

records.title: Addressing Variable Heterogeneity in Distributed Multimodal Training with Entrain
records.reason: Entrain balances heterogeneous multimodal sample workloads in distributed MLLM training through static model parallelism choices; a training framework with no inference contribution.

records.title: PraMem: Practice-derived Experiential Memory for Long-horizon Behavior Prediction
records.reason: PraMem builds practice-derived experiential memory to improve LLM-based long-horizon user behavior prediction; an application of agent memory to behavior prediction, not an inference system.

records.title: Activity Frames: Deterministic Screen-Activity Compilation for Agent Memory and Replay
records.reason: Activity Frames compiles passively captured screen activity into agent memory with a deterministic zero-model pipeline, avoiding repeated frontier-model inference to re-derive routines; an agent memory compilation idea with an inference-cost motivation but no serving mechanism, so borderline.
